reviews.text: Dr Maddy is knowledgeable and really cares about my cats.
Thank you for the 5-stars!!!

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Maddy! She is absolutely amazing and truly goes above and beyond for her patients. She is incredibly knowledgeable, compassionate, and thorough, and it’s obvious how much she genuinely cares about the animals she treats. She took excellent care of my dog, Arizona, and made sure every concern was addressed. Her kindness, patience, and attention to detail really set her apart. Finding a veterinarian you can completely trust with your pets means everything, and Dr. Maddy is exactly that. Arizona is lucky to have her, and I would recommend her to anyone looking for an exceptional veterinarian!

I’ve been searching - for years - for a vet who was not owned by private equity, and would be willing to take the time to understand my dogs unique needs. The vet and entire staff were amazing. They’re communicative, attentive, transparent, patient, and so accommodating. I have already recommended this practice to several friends.

I love this veterinary clinic!! They are very transparent and knowledgeable. They’re very good with animals and aren’t pushy about treatments. They respect owners’ decisions, which are made for a variety of reasons, and which they understand. 10 out of 10 stars!
So happy this practice was recommended to me. My pet gets great care here - they’re all so professional, kind and caring. What a great group!
Dr. Temple and her staff are very caring. You can truly  them with your animals. I highly recommend this practice.

I think this is a great place with professional and caring doctors and staff!  Dr. Temple and Dr. Maddie are wonderful.  They will also help you save money and price match too.  I've never known a dog who enjoys going to the vet but Lou loves to visit.

With vet hospitals and clinics getting bought up by private equity companies and charging an arm and an leg for services, I'm grateful that Animal Care Hospital has not gone down that road!

ACH has been taking very good care of our clowder for over 12 years. Our cats have been seen by several doctors at this clinic, some of whom have since retired, and we have appreciated the compassion and care by all of them. Currently we see Dr. Mady, who is amazing. The technicians are also very good, and the front desk staff have always been great as well.  We are very happy long-time clients and will continue to be.
I have 9 cats and Dr. Maddy and multiple techs do a great job keeping up with them.
Treat animals like angels./ My dog is a pitbull terrier, and she gets along with these people very well. Well, she’s very comfortable around them.
Appreciate their willingness to run electrolytes on my dog with Addison's disease to adjust his meds without an upsell of full blood panel.  Ernest Thanks you!
Wonderful experience here. The staff is friendly, the vet techs are knowledgeable, the Dr was amazing. Great value. This is our new vet clinic.

Dr. Temple has been our vet for more than 20 years because she's the best!!! My dogs always get the best care. I don't even live near the office anymore, but I drive across town for my pups to see her!! Everyone is always amazing front office, techs, everyone!!!

Merlinda's visit to Animal Care Hospital of Phoenix was lovely. Taylor took great care of our pupper and Dr. Jeri was super knowledgeable about our dog's needs for an upcoming international move. At our visit Merlinda received a check up, vaccinations, and a nail clip. It was clear they love animals and are super professional.

We've been going to Animal Care Hospital for nearly 30 years.  Every Vet and Staff member is full of compassion for each and every pet that comes through their door.  Over the years all of the doctors have seen our family of Fur-babies.  We have full confidence in each one of them that they will receive the best care possible.

Most people have had to deal with the loss of a pet and know how difficult it is.  The people at ACH know this too and understand the pain we're going through when a decision to put down a pet is the only solution.  The love and compassion of these doctors and staff is overwhelmingly wonderful.

Look no further for the perfect place to take care of your pets.  Animal Care Hospital is the very best there is.  We wouldn't take our furbabies anywhere else.
Thanks for the 5 stars! We appreciate you.
Love Dr Maddy !!! Absolutely amazing staff and practice. Won't ever take my dogs elsewhere

We were lucky enough to have Dr. Jeri treat OG for cancer in his mouth. We could see and feel that Dr. Jerry really cared for OG our dog she made us feel that everything was going to be just fine. We are so blessed to have Dr. Jeri treat and care for OG, my best friend, my dog you can just feel and tell that she is a very caring doctor and animal lover thank you, Dr. Jerry, James, and Eloice Balazs
The best vet in town if you dog is fearful of the vet. My pitbull is very fearful of the vet and they are so understanding and very patient. They are amazing

Dr. Maddy and Alex were so kind to my dog, River, making sure he was comfortable, not stressed.  Dr. Maddy gave me complete confidence that she knew what was wrong and how to help River heal. We will definitely be going back.
Thanks for the 5 stars!
Very caring and professional staff!
Great vet office.  Clean, convenient appointments.  Very caring staff.
Prompt, courteous, professional service at a VERY reasonable price.
I’ve been bringing all of my dogs here for years and completely trust them with their care..

We've been taking our many pets (dogs and cats) here for many years even though it's a half hour drive to get there. We take our pets for routine checkups, when they've been sick, and when we've had to say goodbye to our furry family members. They always provide caring and outstanding veterinary services. All the vets and staff are exceptional!
The staff and thorough and caring.  I was very satisfied with my visit.
The pet parents are part of the team that keep their pets healthy.  Doctor Temple and her staff are compassionate and caring.
Very pleasant Staff… Treated my dog well.
The best vet I’ve ever been to. Dr temple is amazing and the staff always makes my baby miso feel loved and appreciated.
Thanks for bringing in Teddy Bear! We appreciate your 5-stars too.

All the vets and vet techs here are fantastic. They greet all the animals by name. My animals all love the vets and techs at the animal hospital. Gnar (pictured) especially loves the treats he gets while receiving his vaccinations
Dr Temple is wonderful and staff is great!

Dr. Temple is really excellent with Bella.   We would never trust Bella with anyone else. Staff is always friendly and professional. Doesn't push services on you. Bella is the fourth dog we have taken to her. We have also recommended Dr. Temple to friends. Always happy with their services.

Dr. Temple and her highly capable staff take care of my two golden retrievers.  Dr. Temple is not only a highly competent vet, she is up on the latest treatment research.  Her staff are experienced and professional.  I am very happy with the care my goldens receive at this clinic.
Really nice staff. Very caring and understanding. Took great care of my dog 🐶
Excellent service and very nice staff,  but most importantly, they care and take care of your pets
Best care our pets have ever received ❤️
Have taken great care of my animals for the last 5 years
My pets are well cared for and feel loved the staff are  always so nice and  Dr. Temple is very nice and is an excellent Veterinarian and very thorough.
Thanks for the 5 stars! Also glad you noticed that we ARE priced lower than most.
Veterinary staff was very friendly, knowledgeable, and patient with both my anxious puppy and my many questions. Definitely felt like my dog’s health is cared for with them.

We’ve been taking our two pets to Animal Care Hospital since we moved to Arizona and love it! The staff is always so friendly and you can tell they truly love and enjoy the work they do! They always take such good care of our babies. Big shout out to Dr. Maddie & the crew (including Sprout)!
Exam & vaccination-- and our puppy is so calm about the whole process. The staff takes care of him in a gentle way.
Thanks for the 5 stars! We appreciate it.

My dog had a major flesh wound on his back paw. The team here started the treatments on him. Everything was going smooth, until they kept trying to up the dose of pain meds and sedatives. I agreed to doubling the doses so the technicians can have an easier time doing a bandage change. Every bandage change, the only comments about my dog was that he gets squirmy and thrashy, but does not attempt to bite or get aggressive. The 2nd to last visit, they really pushed tripling the medication doses and if I didn't, they will have to do a sedation injection. I did not feel comfortable giving my dog triple the dose. So the very last visit here, I told them he received double the dose and not triple. From that point on, I was treated so poorly. The doctor looked at me and spoke to me like I am a horrible and abusive dog owner.  The solution I offered, was to allow for me to be the one to hold him down. They told me "we don't typically let the owners back there", "it's all sterilized back there", then the last reason they gave me was "There is a feral cat back there".  Hearing "we typically don't" and then the contradicting statements of "we keep it very sterile", yet you tell me there is a feral cat walking around back there?!  I was baffled.
-Then the doctor tried convincing me that the sedation injection is perfectly safe. I explained and asked, "If you have to take his vitals to ensure he is stable for the injection, plus I have to sign a consent form, in what ways does that suggest it's perfectly safe?" The doctor replies "It is absolutely perfectly safe".... It is absolutely insane for a doctor to completely disregard what effects these drugs have on a dogs stomach, liver, and kidneys and to disregard the concerns of shutting down a nervous system. If you have to CHECK THE VITALS and make the owner SIGN A CONSENT FORM, and the DOCTOR says there is absolutely no risk..... Absolutely mind blowing and very sad. I believe any reasonable person would agree......   I asked for my dog back, and they continued to treat me awfully on my way out.
I also want to acknowledge, every time I spoke, I spoke in a calm, professional way. I never became rude or said anything rude or demeaning.
The last note: Reading through the discharge paperwork and medical notes from this place, the doctor made sure to add a lot of emotion behind the notes. Keep in mind, they sent all of these notes to the new animal hospital, it seems this first place was trying to give a strong negative image of me to the new place.
Again, very unprofessional.

Furthermore, the same day and every day since, I have been taking my dog to a different animal hospital.  The new doctor listened to my concerns, he asked a lot of questions, he was extremely thorough with everything. I was even complimented on how much I care about my dog!!!  I ask the technicians every time how my dog did. Every single time, they told me he did great. He still tries to move around, but he is not aggressive whatsoever. The technicians have had no issues with performing the bandage change.

All in all, my experience at the new hospital was amazing. It validated that I am not a crazy person or that I am a bad dog owner.
If it made sense to sedate my dog, I would. If it made sense to pump triple the recommended dose of drugs into his body, I would.
I really tried my best to understand this animal hospital. I am sure the the "norm" is customers just saying yes to everything and paying for everything without a single question.  Unfortunately to them, I am not that person. I understand it's a business at the end of the day. I understand that everyone involved is trying to do their best with the information and knowledge they have. I understand that their company modo is "a cruel free place", which seems to be just a justification to make you pay for unnecessary prescriptions
I'm sharing all of this because of how I was treated, the illogical reasoning from a doctor, and the unprofessionalism.
Thanks for the five stars!

I cannot say enough good things about Dr Temple, Dr Jeri and the ENTIRE staff at ACH. They always treated our boy Supai so well and gave so much love that he legitimately loved going in no matter the reason. I was surprised that everyone remembered him each time! That was not lost on us and just showed why this place and these people are different.

Unfortunately and unexpectedly we brought him in yesterday to cross the rainbow bridge and they handle it with such care and compassion. I honestly can’t imagine how much more difficult and painful it would’ve been if we didn’t have Dr Jeri and her team there in his finally moment.

We used to live about 5 mins away but recently moved and are now about 25-30 mins away. Idk when we’ll adopt another dog but what I do know is as long as this place is around and these wonderful people work there I do not care how far away they are - we will always bring our dogs here. Thank you for everything ACH ❤️

We’ve been coming here for the past four years for our dog Mac and have consistently had an amazing experience. From the front desk staff to the vet techs and veterinarians, everyone is kind, compassionate, respectful, and incredibly helpful. They always take the time to provide clear information and offer helpful suggestions without ever making us feel pressured. We truly appreciate the level of care they show and highly recommend this place.
